svg.title: Permissions narrow from server to app to deployment
svg.desc: Nested boxes represent permission scopes, not separate processes. The platform admin configures the server; the app admin grants capabilities; developers and agents deploy code within those grants. Alternative execution boundaries are Wasmtime for Boa JavaScript, Rust, or Bochs VM activities; optional native V8 isolates; and Linux VM activities using QEMU or Firecracker, with KVM or emulation. Exec activities run outside these runtime sandboxes.

g.text: Resource limits, runtime configuration, host execution gate
Grants access to secrets, outbound hosts, and approved executables
Code can request capabilities within those grants
Nested permission scopes above; alternative execution sandboxes inside.
Exec activities run host processes outside these runtime sandboxes.
